#Data loading and pre-processing

```{r}
# Load raw data
metadata_raw <- read.csv("data/raw/metadata.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
# Find true duplicates: same location + same soil
soil_cols <- names(metadata_raw)[
  names(metadata_raw) %in% c(
    "Soil_pH", "pH", "Soil_clay", "clay",
    "Soil_N", "T_N", "Soil_CEC", "CEC",
    "Soil_OC", "SOC.g.kg.", "T_Car"
  )
]
# Identify duplicates: same coordinates + same soil properties + same cluster
dup_check <- metadata_raw |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    # Round coordinates to 4 decimal places
    Lon_r = round(as.numeric(Longitude), 4),
    Lat_r = round(as.numeric(Latitude),  4)
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(
    Lon_r, Lat_r,
    Groups,
    dplyr::across(
      dplyr::any_of(soil_cols)
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    n_dup    = dplyr::n(),
    dup_rank = dplyr::row_number()
  ) |>
  dplyr::ungroup()

cat("Groups with duplicates:\n")
dup_check |>
  dplyr::filter(n_dup > 1) |>
  dplyr::select(SampleID, Longitude, Latitude,
                Groups, n_dup,
                dplyr::any_of(soil_cols)) |>
  dplyr::arrange(Long, Lat) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  print()
# Remove true duplicates
metadata_dedup <- dup_check |>
  dplyr::filter(dup_rank == 1) |>
  dplyr::select(-Lon_r, -Lat_r,
                -n_dup, -dup_rank) |>
    ObsID = paste0("OBS_",
                    stringr::str_pad(
                      dplyr::row_number(),
                      width = 3, pad = "0"
                    ))
print(table(metadata_dedup$Groups))
print(table(metadata_dedup$Country))
saveRDS(metadata_dedup, "data/processed/metadata_dedup.rds")

```

#Bioclimatic and soil variables

```{r}
#Nine-country mask
country_lookup <- c(
  "Ang"="Angola", "Esw"="Kingdom of eSwatini", "Eth"="Ethiopia", "Gha"="Ghana",
  "Ken"="Kenya", "Moz"="Mozambique", "Nam"="Namibia", "SA"="South Africa",
  "Sen"="Senegal")
africa_full <- rnaturalearth::ne_countries(
  continent = "africa", returnclass = "sf", scale = "medium") |> sf::st_make_valid()
sampled_mask_sf <- africa_full |>
  filter(name_long %in% country_lookup | name %in% country_lookup)
stopifnot("Expected 9 sampled countries" = nrow(sampled_mask_sf) == 9)
saveRDS(sampled_mask_sf, "data/processed/sampled_mask_sf.rds")
ssa_ext <- terra::ext(-25, 52, -35, 20)

bio_current <- geodata::worldclim_global(
  var="bio", res=2.5, path="data/env_layers"
)
bio_ssa <- terra::crop(bio_current, ssa_ext)

bio_names <- c(
  "BIO1_AnnMeanTemp",  "BIO2_DiurnalRange",
  "BIO3_Isothermality","BIO4_TempSeason",
  "BIO5_MaxTWarmM",    "BIO6_MinTColdM",
  "BIO7_TempAnnRange", "BIO8_MeanTWetQ",
  "BIO9_MeanTDryQ",    "BIO10_MeanTWarmQ",
  "BIO11_MeanTColdQ",  "BIO12_AnnPrec",
  "BIO13_PrecWetM",    "BIO14_PrecDryM",
  "BIO15_PrecSeason",  "BIO16_PrecWetQ",
  "BIO17_PrecDryQ",    "BIO18_PrecWarmQ",
  "BIO19_PrecColdQ"
)
names(bio_ssa) <- bio_names
#SoilGrids 0-30cm weighted mean
soil_path  <- "data/env_layers/soil_world"
soil_vars  <- c("phh2o","soc","nitrogen",
                "clay","cec")
soil_names <- c("Soil_pH","Soil_SOC","Soil_N",
                "Soil_clay","Soil_CEC")
weights    <- c(5,10,15)/30

soil_stack_final <- list()
for (i in seq_along(soil_vars)) {
  v <- soil_vars[i]
  files <- sort(list.files(
    soil_path, pattern=paste0("^",v),
    full.names=TRUE))
  l1 <- terra::crop(terra::rast(files[1]), ssa_ext)
  l2 <- terra::crop(terra::rast(files[2]), ssa_ext)
  l3 <- terra::crop(terra::rast(files[3]), ssa_ext)
  if (!all(dim(l1)[1:2]==dim(l3)[1:2]))
    l3 <- terra::resample(l3, l1, method="bilinear")
  wmean <- weights[1]*l1 + weights[2]*l2 +
           weights[3]*l3
  names(wmean) <- soil_names[i]
  soil_stack_final[[v]] <- wmean
}
soil_stack <- terra::rast(soil_stack_final)

# Resample soil to match bio
soil_stack <- terra::resample(
  soil_stack, bio_ssa[[1]], method="bilinear"
)
names(soil_stack) <- soil_names
saveRDS(soil_stack, "data/processed/soil_stack_0_30cm_wmean.rds")
```

#Geo-referencing

```{r}
SSA_EXT  <- ext(-25, 52, -35, 20)             
THR_FRAC <- 0.05                              # cell is cropland if >= 5% cropland
CAP_KM   <- 25                                # maximum snap distance (km)
wc_path  <- "data/env_layers/climate/wc2.1_2.5m/wc2.1_2.5m_bio_1.tif"
crop_dir <- "data/env_layers/cropland_check"
crop_tif <- file.path(crop_dir, "landuse/landuse/WorldCover_cropland_30s.tif")

# Cropland domain
bio1 <- crop(rast(wc_path), SSA_EXT)

if (!file.exists(crop_tif)) {               
  dir.create(crop_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  geodata::cropland(source = "WorldCover", path = crop_dir)
}
cl <- crop(rast(crop_tif), SSA_EXT)
if (as.numeric(global(cl, "max", na.rm = TRUE)[1, 1]) > 1.5) cl <- cl / 100  # -> 0-1

clg  <- aggregate(cl, fact = 5, fun = "mean", na.rm = TRUE)   
clg  <- resample(clg, bio1, method = "bilinear")
agri <- ifel(clg >= THR_FRAC & !is.na(bio1), 1, NA)           

# Classify occurrences; snap those off the domain
md <- as.data.frame(readRDS("data/processed/metadata_dedup.rds"))
md$Longitude <- as.numeric(md$Longitude)
md$Latitude  <- as.numeric(md$Latitude)

pts     <- vect(as.matrix(md[, c("Longitude", "Latitude")]), crs = "EPSG:4326")
on_mask <- !is.na(terra::extract(agri, pts)[, 2])

md$Longitude_orig        <- md$Longitude
md$Latitude_orig         <- md$Latitude
md$georef_uncertainty_km <- 0
md$coord_status          <- "on_mask"

off <- which(!on_mask)
if (length(off) > 0) {
  nr  <- as.data.frame(nearest(pts[off], as.points(agri)))  
  dkm <- nr$distance / 1000
  ok  <- dkm <= CAP_KM

  md$Longitude[off[ok]] <- nr$to_x[ok]
  md$Latitude[off[ok]]  <- nr$to_y[ok]
  md$georef_uncertainty_km[off] <- round(dkm, 1)
  md$coord_status[off[ok]]  <- "snapped"
  md$coord_status[off[!ok]] <- "review"
}

# Records beyond the 25 km cap correction
review   <- md$coord_status == "review"
keep_idx <- which(review & md$Country == "Ken")   # source-paper GPS: keep as is
drop_idx <- which(review & md$Country == "Sen")   # locality names only: drop

if (length(keep_idx) > 0) {
  md$Longitude[keep_idx] <- md$Longitude_orig[keep_idx]
  md$Latitude[keep_idx]  <- md$Latitude_orig[keep_idx]
  md$georef_uncertainty_km[keep_idx] <- 0
  md$coord_status[keep_idx] <- "kept_paper_coords"
  agri[cellFromXY(agri, as.matrix(md[keep_idx, c("Longitude", "Latitude")]))] <- 1
}

md_final <- if (length(drop_idx) > 0) md[-drop_idx, ] else md

saveRDS(md_final, "data/processed/metadata_coordfixed.rds")
writeRaster(agri, "data/processed/agricultural_mask_worldcover.tif", overwrite = TRUE)
```

#Multicollinearity using VIF

```{r}
sf::sf_use_s2(FALSE)
ssa_ext <- terra::ext(-25,52,-35,20)
pts <- terra::vect(
  as.matrix(metadata[,
    c("Longitude","Latitude")]),
  crs="EPSG:4326")

# Extract all 19 BIO
cat("Loading all 19 WorldClim BIO...\n")
bio_full <- geodata::worldclim_global(
  var="bio", res=2.5,
  path="data/env_layers")
bio_ssa <- terra::crop(bio_full, ssa_ext)

bio_names_all <- c(
  "BIO1_AnnMeanTemp","BIO2_DiurnalRange",
  "BIO3_Isothermality","BIO4_TempSeason",
  "BIO5_MaxTWarmM","BIO6_MinTColdM",
  "BIO7_TempAnnRange","BIO8_MeanTWetQ",
  "BIO9_MeanTDryQ","BIO10_MeanTWarmQ",
  "BIO11_MeanTColdQ","BIO12_AnnPrec",
  "BIO13_PrecWetM","BIO14_PrecDryM",
  "BIO15_PrecSeason","BIO16_PrecWetQ",
  "BIO17_PrecDryQ","BIO18_PrecWarmQ",
  "BIO19_PrecColdQ")
names(bio_ssa) <- bio_names_all

bio_vals <- terra::extract(
  bio_ssa, pts,
  method="bilinear")[,-1]

# Fill any NA with nearest
na_b <- which(rowSums(is.na(bio_vals))>0)
if(length(na_b)>0){
  cat("Filling",length(na_b),"BIO NAs...\n")
  for(i in na_b){
    for(bk in c(10,25,50,100)){
      buf <- terra::buffer(
        pts[i], width=bk*1000)
      v <- terra::extract(bio_ssa, buf,
        fun=function(x) mean(x,na.rm=TRUE))[,-1]
      if(!any(is.na(as.numeric(v)))){
        bio_vals[i,] <- v; break}
    }
  }
}
cat("BIO NAs remaining:",
    sum(is.na(bio_vals)),"\n")

# Extract all soil variables
cat("\nLoading soil stack...\n")
soil_stack <- readRDS("data/processed/soil_stack_0_30cm_wmean.rds")
soil_names <- c("Soil_pH","Soil_SOC","Soil_N", "Soil_clay","Soil_CEC")
names(soil_stack) <- soil_names

soil_vals <- terra::extract(
  soil_stack, pts,
  method="bilinear")[,-1]

na_s <- which(rowSums(is.na(soil_vals))>0)
if(length(na_s)>0){
  cat("Filling",length(na_s),"soil NAs...\n")
  for(i in na_s){
    for(bk in c(10,25,50,100,200)){
      buf <- terra::buffer(
        pts[i], width=bk*1000)
      v <- terra::extract(soil_stack, buf,
        fun=function(x) mean(x,na.rm=TRUE))[,-1]
      if(!any(is.na(as.numeric(v)))){
        soil_vals[i,] <- v; break}
    }
  }
}
cat("Soil NAs remaining:",
    sum(is.na(soil_vals)),"\n")

# Stepwise VIF function
vif_step <- function(df, thresh=10){
  vars <- names(df)
  dropped <- c()
  repeat{
    if(length(vars)<2) break
    vifs <- sapply(vars, function(v){
      others <- setdiff(vars, v)
      r2 <- summary(lm(
        as.formula(paste(v,"~",
          paste(others,collapse="+"))),
        data=df[,vars]))$r.squared
      1/(1-r2)
    })
    if(max(vifs) < thresh) break
    drop <- names(which.max(vifs))
    cat("  Drop:", drop,
        "(VIF=",round(max(vifs),1),")\n")
    dropped <- c(dropped, drop)
    vars <- setdiff(vars, drop)
  }
  list(kept=vars, dropped=dropped,
       final_vif=round(sort(vifs,
         decreasing=TRUE),2))
}

# Screen CLIMATE alone
cat("\n=== CLIMATE VIF screening (19 BIO) ===\n")
bio_df <- as.data.frame(bio_vals) |>
  na.omit()
clim_res <- vif_step(bio_df, thresh=10)
cat("\nClimate kept (",
    length(clim_res$kept),"):\n")
print(clim_res$kept)
cat("\nClimate final VIF:\n")
print(clim_res$final_vif)

#Screen SOIL alone
cat("\n=== SOIL VIF screening (5 soil) ===\n")
soil_df <- as.data.frame(soil_vals) |>
  na.omit()
soil_res <- vif_step(soil_df, thresh=10)
cat("\nSoil kept (",
    length(soil_res$kept),"):\n")
print(soil_res$kept)
cat("\nSoil final VIF:\n")
print(soil_res$final_vif)

# Combine & final joint screen
cat("\n=== COMBINED screening ===\n")
combined_vars <- c(
  clim_res$kept, soil_res$kept)
combined_df <- cbind(
  bio_df[,clim_res$kept,drop=FALSE],
  soil_df[,soil_res$kept,drop=FALSE]) |>
  na.omit()
final_res <- vif_step(
  combined_df, thresh=10)

print(final_res$kept)
print(final_res$final_vif)

# ── Save everything
selected_vars <- final_res$kept
saveRDS(selected_vars, "data/processed/selected_vars.rds")

# Save full extracted values for later
all_env <- data.frame(
  ObsID = metadata$ObsID,
  bio_vals, soil_vals)
saveRDS(all_env,"data/processed/all_env_extracted.rds")

# VIF table
vif_final_table <- data.frame(
  Variable = names(final_res$final_vif),
  VIF = as.numeric(final_res$final_vif),
  Block = ifelse(
    grepl("BIO", names(final_res$final_vif)),
    "Climate","Soil"),
  Retained = "Yes")
write.csv(vif_final_table,"outputs/tables/Table_VIF.csv",
  row.names=FALSE)

#REBUILD ENV STACK with the 12 selected vars (FULL RES)
terraOptions(
  memfrac=0.5,
  tempdir="data/processed/_terratmp")
dir.create("data/processed/_terratmp",
  showWarnings=FALSE, recursive=TRUE)

# bio_ssa (19 WorldClim layers cropped to SSA, named BIO1..BIO19) and soil_stack come from part 1.
# Soil resampled to the WorldClim grid:
soil_ras <- terra::resample(
  soil_stack, bio_ssa[[1]],
  method="bilinear")
names(soil_ras) <- c(
  "Soil_pH","Soil_SOC","Soil_N",
  "Soil_clay","Soil_CEC")

bio_sel  <- selected_vars[
  grepl("BIO", selected_vars)]
soil_sel <- selected_vars[
  grepl("Soil", selected_vars)]

# Build full-res stack
env_rast <- c(
  bio_ssa[[bio_sel]],
  soil_ras[[soil_sel]])
env_rast <- env_rast[[selected_vars]]
cat("\nStack layers:",
    terra::nlyr(env_rast),"\n")
print(names(env_rast))

# Apply WorldCover mask (full res)
agri_wc <- terra::rast(
  "data/processed/agricultural_mask_worldcover.tif")
agri_wc <- terra::resample(
  agri_wc, env_rast[[1]], method="near")

env_rast_masked <- terra::mask(
  env_rast, agri_wc)

terra::writeRaster(
  env_rast_masked, "data/processed/env_rast_masked.tif",
  overwrite=TRUE)
cat("\nFull-res masked stack saved\n")
print(env_rast_masked)

# EXTRACT ENV VALUES AT CORRECTED COORDINATES

pts <- terra::vect(
  as.matrix(metadata[,
    c("Longitude","Latitude")]),
  crs="EPSG:4326")

# Extract from masked stack
env_vals <- terra::extract(
  env_rast_masked, pts,
  method="bilinear")[,-1]

cat("Extraction from masked stack:\n")
cat("NA rows:",
    sum(rowSums(is.na(env_vals))>0),
    "\n")

#Fix any remaining NAs with unmasked
na_rows <- which(
  rowSums(is.na(env_vals))>0)

if (length(na_rows)>0) {
  cat("Fixing", length(na_rows),
      "NA rows with unmasked stack...\n")

  env_rast_unmasked <- terra::aggregate(
    env_rast, fact=2, method="bilinear")

  unmasked_fix <- terra::extract(
    env_rast_unmasked,
    pts[na_rows],
    method="bilinear")[,-1]

  env_vals[na_rows,] <- unmasked_fix

  still_na <- which(
    rowSums(is.na(env_vals))>0)
  cat("Still NA after unmasked fix:",
      length(still_na),"\n")

  if (length(still_na)>0) {
    print(metadata[still_na,] |>
      dplyr::select(
        ObsID,Country,
        Longitude,Latitude))
  }
}

env_df <- metadata |>
  dplyr::select(
    ObsID, Study, Country,
    Plant_host, Longitude,
    Latitude, Groups
  ) |>
  dplyr::bind_cols(
    as.data.frame(env_vals)
)

print(names(env_df))
print(summary(env_df[, selected_vars]))

saveRDS(env_df, "data/processed/env_df.rds")

# VIF check with corrected data
cat("\n=== VIF check ===\n")
vif_check <- car::vif(lm(
  BIO1_AnnMeanTemp ~ .,
  data=env_df |>
    dplyr::select(
      dplyr::all_of(selected_vars)) |>
    na.omit()))
print(round(sort(vif_check,
                  decreasing=TRUE),2))
cat("Max VIF:", round(max(vif_check),2),"\n")
```

#Predictors table

```{r}
descriptions <- c(
  BIO2_DiurnalRange="Mean diurnal temperature range",
  BIO4_TempSeason="Temperature seasonality",
  BIO8_MeanTWetQ="Mean temp. of wettest quarter",
  BIO14_PrecDryM="Precipitation of driest month",
  BIO15_PrecSeason="Precipitation seasonality",
  BIO16_PrecWetQ="Precipitation of wettest quarter",
  BIO18_PrecWarmQ="Precipitation of warmest quarter",
  BIO19_PrecColdQ="Precipitation of coldest quarter",
  Soil_pH="Soil pH (H2O)", Soil_N="Total nitrogen",
  Soil_clay="Clay content",
  Soil_CEC="Cation exchange capacity")
units_vec <- c(
  BIO2_DiurnalRange="deg C",BIO4_TempSeason="deg Cx100",
  BIO8_MeanTWetQ="deg C",BIO14_PrecDryM="mm",
  BIO15_PrecSeason="CV",BIO16_PrecWetQ="mm",
  BIO18_PrecWarmQ="mm",BIO19_PrecColdQ="mm",
  Soil_pH="-",Soil_N="g/kg",Soil_clay="%",
  Soil_CEC="cmol/kg")
pred_table <- purrr::map_dfr(selected_vars, function(v){
  x <- env_df[[v]]; x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  data.frame(Variable=v, Description=descriptions[v],
    Unit=units_vec[v],
    Type=ifelse(grepl("BIO",v),
      "Climate (WorldClim v2.1)",
      "Soil (SoilGrids v2.0)"),
    N=length(x), Mean=round(mean(x),2),
    SD=round(sd(x),2), Min=round(min(x),2),
    Max=round(max(x),2))
})
write.csv(pred_table,"outputs/tables/Table_predictors.csv",row.names=FALSE)
print(as.data.frame(pred_table[,
  c("Variable","Mean","SD","Min","Max")]))
```

#Map with sampling points

```{r}
library(terra); library(sf)
library(ggplot2); library(tidyverse)
library(ggnewscale)
sf::sf_use_s2(FALSE)

africa_outline <- rnaturalearth::ne_countries(
  continent = "africa", returnclass = "sf", scale = "medium") |>
  sf::st_make_valid() |> sf::st_union() |> sf::st_make_valid()

# ── cropland = non-NA footprint of the masked stack ──
env       <- terra::rast("data/processed/env_rast_masked.tif")[[1]]
crop_mask <- terra::ifel(!is.na(env), 1, NA)
crop_mask <- terra::mask(crop_mask,
                         terra::vect(sampled_mask_sf |> sf::st_make_valid() |>
                                       sf::st_union() |> sf::st_make_valid()))
cdf <- as.data.frame(crop_mask, xy = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)
names(cdf)[3] <- "v"
cdf$lab <- "Cropland"
cat("Cropland cells:", nrow(cdf), "\n")

# ── occurrence points ────────────────────────────────
pts <- metadata |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Longitude), !is.na(Latitude), !is.na(Plant_host)) |>
  dplyr::add_count(Plant_host, name = "n_host") |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n_host))   

host_cols <- c("Ar_hy" = "#0072B2",     
               "Gl_ma" = "red",     
               "Ph_vu" = "yellow",     
               "Vi_un" = "purple")     

host_shapes <- c("Ar_hy" = 21,          
                 "Gl_ma" = 22,          
                 "Ph_vu" = 23,          
                 "Vi_un" = 24)          

host_labs <- c("Ar_hy" = "Ar_hy",
               "Gl_ma" = "Gl_max",
               "Ph_vu" = "Ph_vu",
               "Vi_un" = "Vi_ung")

p <- ggplot2::ggplot() +
  ggplot2::geom_sf(data = africa_outline,
                   fill = "#EFEFEF", colour = "grey45", linewidth = 0.3) +
  ggplot2::geom_sf(data = sampled_mask_sf,
                   fill = "#DCE9F5", colour = NA) +
  # CROPLAND in green
  ggplot2::geom_raster(data = cdf, ggplot2::aes(x, y, fill = lab)) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Cropland" = "#6B9A4E"), name = NULL,
    guide  = ggplot2::guide_legend(order = 2, override.aes = list(size = 4))) +
  ggplot2::geom_sf(data = sampled_mask_sf,
                   fill = NA, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.4) +
  # ── reset fill so points get their own fill scale ──
  ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
  ggplot2::geom_point(data = pts,
                      ggplot2::aes(Longitude, Latitude,
                                   fill = Plant_host, shape = Plant_host),
                      colour = "grey15", size = 2.3, stroke = 0.3, alpha = 0.85,
                      position = ggplot2::position_jitter(
                        width = 0.06, height = 0.06, seed = 42)) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = host_cols, labels = host_labs,
                             name = "Plant host") +

                              name = "Plant host") +

    fill  = ggplot2::guide_legend(order = 1,
                                  override.aes = list(size = 3.6, alpha = 1, shape = host_shapes)),
    shape = ggplot2::guide_legend(order = 1,
                                  override.aes = list(size = 3.6, alpha = 1, fill = host_cols))) +
  ggplot2::coord_sf(xlim = c(-20, 52), ylim = c(-35, 38), expand = FALSE) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
```

#FUTURE STACKS: 3-GCM ENSEMBLE MEAN (ACCESS-CM2, MPI-ESM1-2-HR, IPSL-CM6A-LR)

```{r}
terraOptions(
  memfrac=0.5,
  tempdir="data/processed/_terratmp")
options(timeout=3600)

ssa_ext <- terra::ext(-25,52,-35,20)
selected_vars <- readRDS("data/processed/selected_vars.rds")
env_rast_masked <- terra::rast("data/processed/env_rast_masked.tif")
ref_grid <- env_rast_masked[[1]]
agri_wc <- terra::rast("data/processed/agricultural_mask_worldcover.tif")
agri_wc <- terra::resample(
  agri_wc, ref_grid, method="near")

bio_sel  <- selected_vars[
  grepl("BIO", selected_vars)]
soil_sel <- selected_vars[
  grepl("Soil", selected_vars)]

soil_stack <- readRDS(
  "data/processed/soil_stack_0_30cm_wmean.rds")
names(soil_stack) <- c(
  "Soil_pH","Soil_SOC","Soil_N",
  "Soil_clay","Soil_CEC")
soil_res <- terra::resample(
  soil_stack, ref_grid, method="bilinear")
names(soil_res) <- c(
  "Soil_pH","Soil_SOC","Soil_N",
  "Soil_clay","Soil_CEC")
soil_layer <- soil_res[[soil_sel]]

bio_names_all <- c(
  "BIO1_AnnMeanTemp","BIO2_DiurnalRange",
  "BIO3_Isothermality","BIO4_TempSeason",
  "BIO5_MaxTWarmM","BIO6_MinTColdM",
  "BIO7_TempAnnRange","BIO8_MeanTWetQ",
  "BIO9_MeanTDryQ","BIO10_MeanTWarmQ",
  "BIO11_MeanTColdQ","BIO12_AnnPrec",
  "BIO13_PrecWetM","BIO14_PrecDryM",
  "BIO15_PrecSeason","BIO16_PrecWetQ",
  "BIO17_PrecDryQ","BIO18_PrecWarmQ",
  "BIO19_PrecColdQ")

gcm_models <- c(
  "ACCESS-CM2",
  "MPI-ESM1-2-HR",
  "IPSL-CM6A-LR")

scen_map <- list(
  SSP245_2050=list(ssp="245",time="2041-2060"),
  SSP585_2050=list(ssp="585",time="2041-2060"),
  SSP245_2070=list(ssp="245",time="2061-2080"),
  SSP585_2070=list(ssp="585",time="2061-2080"))

for (sc in names(scen_map)) {
  cat("\n=== Building future:", sc, "===\n")
  info <- scen_map[[sc]]
  out_fp <- paste0(
    "data/processed/future_",sc,".tif")
  if (file.exists(out_fp)) {
    cat("  Exists, skip\n"); next
  }

  # Download each GCM, collect bio_sel
  gcm_stacks <- list()
  for (gm in gcm_models) {
    cat("  GCM:", gm, "...")
    fb <- tryCatch(
      geodata::cmip6_world(
        model=gm, ssp=info$ssp,
        time=info$time, var="bioc",
        res=2.5,
        path="data/env_layers"),
      error=function(e){
        cat("ERR:",e$message,"\n")
        NULL})
    if (is.null(fb)) next
    fb <- terra::crop(fb, ssa_ext)
    names(fb) <- bio_names_all
    gcm_stacks[[gm]] <- fb[[bio_sel]]
    cat("ok\n")
  }

  if (length(gcm_stacks)==0) {
    cat("  No GCMs downloaded!\n"); next
  }

  # Average across GCMs, per variable
  cat("  Averaging",
      length(gcm_stacks),"GCMs...\n")
  fut_bio_mean <- gcm_stacks[[1]]
  if (length(gcm_stacks)>1) {
    for (v in bio_sel) {
      layers <- terra::rast(lapply(
        gcm_stacks, function(s) s[[v]]))
      fut_bio_mean[[v]] <- terra::app(
        layers, mean, na.rm=TRUE)
    }
  }

  fut_bio_mean <- terra::resample(
    fut_bio_mean, ref_grid,
    method="bilinear")

  fut_stack <- c(fut_bio_mean, soil_layer)
  fut_stack <- fut_stack[[selected_vars]]
  fut_stack <- terra::mask(fut_stack, agri_wc)

  terra::writeRaster(
    fut_stack, out_fp, overwrite=TRUE)
  cat("  Saved:", terra::nlyr(fut_stack),
      "layers\n")
  rm(gcm_stacks, fut_bio_mean, fut_stack)
  gc()
}
```

#Ensemble SDM

```{r}
out_dir <- file.path(getwd(),"outputs","biomod2")
# Background points (within agri mask)
cat("Building background...\n")
agri_mask_for_bg <- terra::resample(
  agri_wc, env_rast_masked[[1]],
  method="near")

sampled_union <- sampled_mask_sf |>
  sf::st_union() |> sf::st_make_valid()
agri_poly <- terra::as.polygons(
  agri_mask_for_bg, dissolve=TRUE) |>
  sf::st_as_sf() |> sf::st_make_valid() |>
  sf::st_intersection(sampled_union) |>
  sf::st_make_valid()

set.seed(42)
bg_pts <- terra::spatSample(
  terra::vect(agri_poly),
  size=10000, method="random")
bg_env <- terra::extract(
  env_rast_masked, bg_pts,
  method="bilinear")[,-1]
bg_coords <- terra::crds(bg_pts)
keep <- rowSums(is.na(bg_env))==0
bg_env <- bg_env[keep,]
bg_coords <- bg_coords[keep,]
saveRDS(list(env=bg_env,coords=bg_coords),"data/processed/background_final.rds")

# Model each group
sdm_results <- list()

for (g in sdm_groups) {
  g_clean <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]","_",g)
  cat("\n",strrep("=",45),"\n")
  cat("MODELING:", g, "\n")
  cat(strrep("=",45),"\n")

  pres_g <- env_df |>
    dplyr::filter(Groups==g)
  n_pres <- nrow(pres_g)
  cat("n presence:", n_pres,"\n")

  pres_env <- pres_g |>
    dplyr::select(
      dplyr::all_of(selected_vars))
  pres_coords <- pres_g |>
    dplyr::select(Longitude, Latitude)

  all_env <- rbind(pres_env, bg_env)
  all_coords <- rbind(
    pres_coords,
    data.frame(
      Longitude=bg_coords[,1],
      Latitude =bg_coords[,2]))
  resp_var <- c(
    rep(1,n_pres), rep(0,nrow(bg_env)))

  bm_data <- tryCatch(
    biomod2::BIOMOD_FormatingData(
      resp.var = resp_var,
      expl.var = all_env,
      resp.xy  = all_coords,
      resp.name= g_clean,
      dir.name = out_dir),
    error=function(e){
      cat("Format error:",e$message,"\n")
      NULL})
  if (is.null(bm_data)) next

  bm_mod <- tryCatch(
    biomod2::BIOMOD_Modeling(
      bm.format   = bm_data,
      modeling.id = g_clean,
      models      = c("GLM","GBM",
                       "RF","MAXNET"),
      CV.strategy = "kfold",
      CV.k        = 5,
      CV.nb.rep   = 5,
      CV.do.full.models = FALSE,
      var.import  = 3,
      metric.eval = c("TSS","AUCroc"),
      seed.val    = 42),
    error=function(e){
      cat("Model error:",e$message,"\n")
      NULL})
  if (is.null(bm_mod)) next

  eval_chk <- biomod2::get_evaluations(bm_mod)
  cat("Algos:",
      paste(unique(eval_chk$algo),
            collapse=", "),"\n")

  bm_ens <- tryCatch(
    biomod2::BIOMOD_EnsembleModeling(
      bm.mod        = bm_mod,
      models.chosen = "all",
      em.by         = "all",
      metric.select = "TSS",
      metric.select.thresh = 0.4,
      metric.eval   = c("TSS","AUCroc"),
      em.algo       = "EMmean",
      var.import    = 3,
      seed.val      = 42),
    error=function(e){
      cat("Ensemble error:",e$message,"\n")
      NULL})
  if (is.null(bm_ens)) next

  # Project current at FULL resolution
  cat("Projecting current...\n")
  bm_proj <- tryCatch(
    biomod2::BIOMOD_EnsembleForecasting(
      bm.em       = bm_ens,
      new.env     = env_rast_masked,
      proj.name   = paste0(g_clean,"_current"),
      models.chosen = "all",
      on_0_1000   = TRUE),
    error=function(e){
      cat("Proj error:",e$message,"\n")
      NULL})

  sdm_results[[g]] <- list(
    bm_mod = bm_mod,
    bm_ens = bm_ens,
    eval   = biomod2::get_evaluations(bm_mod),
    vi     = biomod2::get_variables_importance(bm_mod))

  saveRDS(sdm_results,"outputs/models/sdm_results_final_progress.rds")
  cat("Saved progress:", g,"\n")
  gc()
}
saveRDS(sdm_results,"outputs/models/sdm_results_final.rds")

# Fallback for lineages that failed above (Windows long-path limit).
# Original run: only R. leguminosarum_cluster. Uses a short directory and a short
# response name; algorithms, folds, seeds and thresholds are identical.

missing_groups <- setdiff(sdm_groups, names(sdm_results))
short_names <- c("R. leguminosarum_cluster" = "Rleg", "M. tropici_cluster" = "Mtrop")
short_dir   <- "C:/sdm_tmp"          
dir.create(short_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

for (g in missing_groups) {
  sn <- if (g %in% names(short_names)) short_names[[g]] else
    gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "", g)
  cat("Re-running with short path:", g, "as", sn, "\n")
  # remove any half-written project folder left by the failed long-path attempt
  unlink(file.path(out_dir, gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9\\.]", ".", gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "_", g))),
         recursive = TRUE, force = TRUE)
  pres_g   <- env_df |> dplyr::filter(Groups == g)
  pres_env <- pres_g |> dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(selected_vars))
  all_env    <- rbind(pres_env, bg_env)
  all_coords <- rbind(pres_g |> dplyr::select(Longitude, Latitude),
                      data.frame(Longitude = bg_coords[, 1], Latitude = bg_coords[, 2]))
  resp_var   <- c(rep(1, nrow(pres_g)), rep(0, nrow(bg_env)))

  bm_data <- biomod2::BIOMOD_FormatingData(
    resp.var = resp_var, expl.var = all_env, resp.xy = all_coords,
    resp.name = sn, dir.name = short_dir)
  bm_mod <- biomod2::BIOMOD_Modeling(
    bm.format = bm_data, modeling.id = sn,
    models = c("GLM", "GBM", "RF", "MAXNET"),
    CV.strategy = "kfold", CV.k = 5, CV.nb.rep = 5, CV.do.full.models = FALSE,
    var.import = 3, metric.eval = c("TSS", "AUCroc"), seed.val = 42)
  bm_ens <- biomod2::BIOMOD_EnsembleModeling(
    bm.mod = bm_mod, models.chosen = "all", em.by = "all",
    metric.select = "TSS", metric.select.thresh = 0.4,
    metric.eval = c("TSS", "AUCroc"), em.algo = "EMmean",
    var.import = 3, seed.val = 42)
  biomod2::BIOMOD_EnsembleForecasting(
    bm.em = bm_ens, new.env = env_rast_masked,
    proj.name = paste0(sn, "_current"), models.chosen = "all", on_0_1000 = TRUE)

  sdm_results[[g]] <- list(
    bm_mod = bm_mod, bm_ens = bm_ens,
    eval = biomod2::get_evaluations(bm_mod),
    vi   = biomod2::get_variables_importance(bm_mod),
    short_name = sn, short_dir = short_dir)
  saveRDS(sdm_results, "outputs/models/sdm_results_final.rds")
}
cat("Lineages modelled:", length(sdm_results), "of", length(sdm_groups), "\n")
```

#Future projections

```{r}
scenarios <- c("SSP245_2050", "SSP585_2050", "SSP245_2070", "SSP585_2070")
short_map <- c(
  "Rhizobium_cluster" = "Rhiz", "Bradyrhizobium_novel" = "Bnov",
  "B. elkanii_cluster" = "Belk", "B. japonicum_cluster" = "Bjap",
  "Bradyrhizobium_cluster" = "Bcl", "R. phaseoli_cluster" = "Rpha",
  "R. leguminosarum_cluster" = "Rleg", "M. tropici_cluster" = "Mtrop",
  "R. radiobacter_cluster" = "Rrad")

roots <- c(file.path(getwd(), "outputs", "biomod2"), "C:/sdm_tmp")
roots <- roots[dir.exists(roots)]

# Locate the ensemble GeoTIFF of one biomod2 projection
find_tif <- function(proj_name) {
  f <- list.files(roots, pattern = "ensemble\\.tif$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
  f <- f[grepl(paste0("/proj_", proj_name, "/"), f)]
  if (length(f)) f[1] else NA_character_
}
# write the EMmean layer to outputs
save_tif <- function(src, dest) {
  r <- terra::rast(src)
  if (terra::nlyr(r) > 1) {
    em <- grep("EMmean", names(r), ignore.case = TRUE)
    r <- if (length(em)) r[[em[1]]] else r[[1]]
  }
  terra::writeRaster(r, dest, overwrite = TRUE)
}

for (g in sdm_groups) {
  g_clean <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "_", g)
  sn      <- short_map[[g]]
  bm_ens  <- sdm_results[[g]]$bm_ens
  if (is.null(bm_ens)) { cat("No ensemble for", g, "- skipped\n"); next }
  cat("\n===", g, "(", sn, ") ===\n")

  #Current climate
  dest <- paste0("outputs/models/", g_clean, "_current.tif")
  cur_names <- unique(c(paste0(g_clean, "_current"), paste0(sn, "_current")))
  src <- NA_character_
  for (pn in cur_names) if (is.na(src)) src <- find_tif(pn)
  if (is.na(src)) {
    env_cur <- terra::rast("data/processed/env_rast_masked.tif")
    biomod2::BIOMOD_EnsembleForecasting(bm.em = bm_ens, new.env = env_cur,
      proj.name = paste0(sn, "_current"), models.chosen = "all", on_0_1000 = TRUE)
    src <- find_tif(paste0(sn, "_current"))
  }
  stopifnot("current projection not found" = !is.na(src))
  save_tif(src, dest); cat("  current OK\n")

# Future scenarios
  for (sc in scenarios) {
    dest <- paste0("outputs/models/", g_clean, "_", sc, ".tif")
    if (file.exists(dest)) { cat("  ", sc, "exists, skipped\n"); next }
    src <- find_tif(paste0(sn, "_", sc))
    if (is.na(src)) {
      fut_stack <- terra::rast(paste0("data/processed/future_", sc, ".tif"))
      biomod2::BIOMOD_EnsembleForecasting(bm.em = bm_ens, new.env = fut_stack,
        proj.name = paste0(sn, "_", sc), models.chosen = "all", on_0_1000 = TRUE)
      src <- find_tif(paste0(sn, "_", sc))
      rm(fut_stack); invisible(gc())
    }
    stopifnot("future projection not found" = !is.na(src))
    save_tif(src, dest); cat("  ", sc, "OK\n")
  }
}

# Check one resolution, values on the 0-1000 scale
all_sc <- c("current", scenarios)
chk <- do.call(rbind, lapply(sdm_groups, function(g) {
  g_clean <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "_", g)
  do.call(rbind, lapply(all_sc, function(sc) {
    fp <- paste0("outputs/models/", g_clean, "_", sc, ".tif")
    if (!file.exists(fp)) return(data.frame(file = basename(fp), res = NA, max = NA))
    r <- terra::rast(fp)
    data.frame(file = basename(fp), res = round(terra::res(r)[1], 4),
               max = as.numeric(terra::global(r, "max", na.rm = TRUE)[1, 1]))
  }))
}))
print(chk, row.names = FALSE)
stopifnot("missing rasters" = !anyNA(chk$res),
          "resolution mismatch among rasters" = length(unique(chk$res)) == 1,
          "values not on the 0-1000 scale" = all(chk$max > 0 & chk$max <= 1000))
cat("\nAll", nrow(chk), "rasters present, one resolution (", unique(chk$res), "deg).\n")
```

#Performance metrics

```{r}
sdm_results <- readRDS("outputs/models/sdm_results_final.rds")
sdm_groups <- readRDS("data/processed/sdm_groups.rds")

# Pull evaluation scores from each biomod2 object
ev_all <- purrr::map_dfr(sdm_groups, function(g){
  bm <- sdm_results[[g]]$bm_mod
  e <- biomod2::get_evaluations(bm)
  e$Group <- g
  e
})

cat("=== Columns available ===\n")
print(names(ev_all))

print(unique(ev_all$metric.eval))
cat("\nAlgorithms:\n")

# Per cluster × algorithm × metric
perf_algo <- ev_all |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(validation)) |>
  dplyr::group_by(Group, algo, metric.eval) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean = round(mean(validation, na.rm=TRUE), 3),
    sd   = round(sd(validation,   na.rm=TRUE), 3),
    n    = dplyr::n(), .groups="drop") |>
  dplyr::mutate(value = paste0(mean, " \u00b1 ", sd))

  dplyr::filter(!is.na(validation)) |>

    mean = round(mean(validation, na.rm=TRUE), 3),
    sd   = round(sd(validation,   na.rm=TRUE), 3),
    .groups="drop") |>
  dplyr::mutate(value = paste0(mean, " \u00b1 ", sd)) |>
  dplyr::select(Group, metric.eval, value) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from=metric.eval,
                     values_from=value)

# CBI on continuous current output
cbi_tab <- purrr::map_dfr(sdm_groups, function(g){
  g_c <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]","_",g)
  r <- terra::rast(paste0(
    "outputs/models/",g_c,"_current.tif"))
  pxy <- metadata |>
    dplyr::filter(Groups==g) |>
    dplyr::select(Longitude,Latitude)
  pres_suit <- terra::extract(r,
    as.matrix(pxy))[,1]
  pres_suit <- pres_suit[!is.na(pres_suit)]
  all_suit <- terra::values(r)
  all_suit <- all_suit[!is.na(all_suit)]
  b <- tryCatch(
    ecospat::ecospat.boyce(
      fit=all_suit, obs=pres_suit,
      nclass=0, PEplot=FALSE)$cor,
    error=function(e) NA)
  data.frame(Group=g, n=length(pres_suit),
    CBI=round(b,3))
})
print(as.data.frame(cbi_tab), row.names=FALSE)
cat("\n(CBI: +1 = perfect, 0 = random,",
    "<0 = worse than random)\n")
write.csv(cbi_tab,"outputs/tables/CBI_continuous.csv",row.names=FALSE)

perf_lin <- perf_lin |> dplyr::left_join(cbi_tab, by="Group")
print(as.data.frame(perf_lin), row.names=FALSE)
write.csv(perf_lin,"outputs/tables/performance_by_lineage.csv",row.names=FALSE)
```

```{r}
vi_all <- list()

for (g in sdm_groups) {

    dplyr::mutate(
      sd_imp=tidyr::replace_na(sd_imp,0),
      Group=g,
      var_label=dplyr::recode(expl.var,
        !!!var_labels, .default=expl.var),
      var_label=forcats::fct_reorder(
        var_label, mean_imp))

  vi_all[[g]] <- vi_g

  g_col <- group_cols[g]
  if (is.na(g_col)) g_col <- "steelblue"
  n_rec <- sum(metadata$Groups==g)

 p_vi <- ggplot2::ggplot(vi_g, ggplot2::aes(x=var_label, y=mean_imp)) +
  ggplot2::geom_bar(stat="identity", fill=g_col, colour="grey20",
    width=0.7, linewidth=0.3) +
  ggplot2::coord_flip() +
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, max(vi_g$mean_imp, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.15),
    expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = paste0("Variable importance \u2014 ", gsub("_"," ",g)),
    x = NULL, y = "Variable importance") +
  ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size=12) +
  ggplot2::theme(
    plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(size=13, face="bold.italic", hjust=0.5),
    axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_text(size=20, colour="black"),
    axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(size=15, colour="black"),
    panel.grid.major.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    panel.border = ggplot2::element_rect(colour="black", fill=NA, linewidth=1),
    plot.background = ggplot2::element_rect(fill="white", colour=NA))
 
  ggplot2::ggsave(paste0("outputs/figures/Fig_VI_", g_clean,".png"),p_vi, width=9, height=7,dpi=300, bg="white")

}

#Partial dependence plots
map_label <- function(x){
  out <- var_labels[x]
  out[is.na(out)] <- x[is.na(out)]
  unname(out)
}
for (g in sdm_groups) {
  g_clean <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]","_",g)
  cat("PDP:", g, "\n")
  bm_mod <- sdm_results[[g]]$bm_mod
  if (is.null(bm_mod)) next
  top_vars <- vi_all[[g]] |>
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(mean_imp)) |>
    dplyr::slice(1:min(6,dplyr::n())) |>  
    dplyr::pull(expl.var)
  pdp_raw <- tryCatch(
    biomod2::bm_PlotResponseCurves(
      bm.out=bm_mod, models.chosen="all",
      fixed.var="mean", do.plot=FALSE,
      nb.pts=100),
    error=function(e){
      cat("  err:",e$message,"\n"); NULL})
  if (is.null(pdp_raw)) next
  pdp_df <- pdp_raw$tab |>
    as.data.frame() |>
    dplyr::filter(expl.name %in% top_vars) |>
    dplyr::group_by(expl.name, expl.val) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      mean_resp=mean(pred.val,na.rm=TRUE),
      sd_resp=sd(pred.val,na.rm=TRUE),
      .groups="drop") |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      sd_resp=tidyr::replace_na(sd_resp,0),
      var_label=map_label(expl.name))
  # Order facets by importance
  lab_order <- map_label(top_vars)
  pdp_df$var_label <- factor(
    pdp_df$var_label,
    levels=unique(lab_order))
  if (nrow(pdp_df)==0) next
  g_col <- group_cols[g]
  if (is.na(g_col)) g_col <- "steelblue"
  n_rec <- sum(metadata$Groups==g)
  p_pdp <- ggplot2::ggplot(pdp_df,
    ggplot2::aes(x=expl.val, y=mean_resp)) +
    ggplot2::geom_ribbon(
      ggplot2::aes(
        ymin=pmax(0,mean_resp-sd_resp),
        ymax=pmin(1,mean_resp+sd_resp)),
      fill=g_col, alpha=0.25) +
    ggplot2::geom_line(
      colour=g_col, linewidth=1.1) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
      limits=c(0,1),
      breaks=c(0,.25,.5,.75,1),
      labels=scales::percent_format()) +
    ggplot2::facet_wrap(
      ~var_label, scales="free_x", ncol=3, nrow=2) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title=paste0(
        "Partial dependence \u2014 ",
        gsub("_"," ",g)),
      subtitle="Six most important predictors (ranked by permutation importance)",
      x="Variable value",
      y="Habitat suitability") +
    ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size=11) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.title=ggplot2::element_text(
        size=12,face="bold.italic",hjust=0.5),
      plot.subtitle=ggplot2::element_text(
        size=9,hjust=0.5,colour="grey40"),
      strip.text=ggplot2::element_text(
        size=20,face="bold"),
      strip.background=ggplot2::element_rect(
        fill="grey95"),
      axis.text=ggplot2::element_text(
        size=18,colour="black"),
      panel.grid.minor=
        ggplot2::element_blank(),
      panel.border=ggplot2::element_rect(
        colour="black",fill=NA,linewidth=1.5),
      plot.background=ggplot2::element_rect(
        fill="white",colour=NA))
  ggplot2::ggsave(paste0("outputs/figures/Fig_PDP_",g_clean,".png"),p_pdp, width=13, height=9,dpi=300, bg="white")
}
```

#Thresholding of continuous suitability in core and margin zones

```{r}
#Extract TSS-optimal thresholds (models)
tss_thresh <- purrr::map_dfr(
  sdm_groups, function(g){
    e <- sdm_results[[g]]$eval
    if (is.null(e)) return(NULL)
    cutoff <- e |>
      dplyr::filter(metric.eval=="TSS",
        !is.na(cutoff)) |>
      dplyr::pull(cutoff) |>
      mean(na.rm=TRUE)
    data.frame(
      Group=g,
      TSS_cutoff=round(cutoff,1))
  })
saveRDS(tss_thresh,"data/processed/tss_thresh.rds")

ref <- terra::rast(
  "outputs/models/Rhizobium_cluster_current.tif")
a_all <- terra::values(terra::cellSize(ref, unit = "km", mask = FALSE))[, 1]   # latitude-correct cell area (km2)
sampled_v <- terra::vect(
  sampled_mask_sf |> sf::st_make_valid() |>
  sf::st_union() |> sf::st_make_valid())

cmp <- purrr::map_dfr(sdm_groups, function(g){
  g_c <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]","_",g)

  cur <- terra::mask(terra::rast(paste0(
    "outputs/models/",g_c,"_current.tif")),
    sampled_v)
  vals_all <- terra::values(cur)[, 1]; ok_v <- !is.na(vals_all)
  vals <- vals_all[ok_v]; a_ok <- a_all[ok_v]

  # Suitability AT occurrence points
  pres_xy <- metadata |>
    dplyr::filter(Groups==g) |>
    dplyr::select(Longitude, Latitude)
  pres_suit <- terra::extract(
    terra::rast(paste0(
      "outputs/models/",g_c,"_current.tif")),
    as.matrix(pres_xy))[,1]
  pres_suit <- pres_suit[!is.na(pres_suit)]

  #Method 1: TSS-max
  thr_tss <- tss_thresh |>
    dplyr::filter(Group==g) |> dplyr::pull(TSS_cutoff)

  # Method 2: maxSSS threshold maximising sensitivity+specificity,computed from biomod2 eval cutoffs (TSS uses same criterion); approximate via presence vs background
  bg <- readRDS("data/processed/background_final.rds")
  bg_suit <- terra::extract(
    terra::rast(paste0(
      "outputs/models/",g_c,"_current.tif")),
    as.matrix(bg$coords))[,1]
  bg_suit <- bg_suit[!is.na(bg_suit)]
  thr_seq <- seq(1, 999, by=2)
  ss <- sapply(thr_seq, function(th){
    sens <- mean(pres_suit >= th)
    spec <- mean(bg_suit  <  th)
    sens + spec
  })
  thr_maxsss <- thr_seq[which.max(ss)]

  # Method 3: 10th percentile training presence
  thr_p10 <- as.numeric(
    quantile(pres_suit, 0.10, na.rm=TRUE))

  # Method 4: fixed 0.3 (300)
  thr_fix <- 300

  # Areas for each
  area_of <- function(th)
    sum(a_ok[vals >= th])
  pct_pres_excl <- function(th)
    round(mean(pres_suit < th)*100,1)

  data.frame(
    Group=g, n=length(pres_suit),
    pres_median=round(median(pres_suit),0),
    pres_p10=round(thr_p10,0),
    # TSS
    TSS_thr=round(thr_tss,0),
    TSS_km2=round(area_of(thr_tss),0),
    TSS_presExcl=pct_pres_excl(thr_tss),
    # maxSSS
    maxSSS_thr=thr_maxsss,
    maxSSS_km2=round(area_of(thr_maxsss),0),
    maxSSS_presExcl=pct_pres_excl(thr_maxsss),
    # p10
    p10_thr=round(thr_p10,0),
    p10_km2=round(area_of(thr_p10),0),
    p10_presExcl=pct_pres_excl(thr_p10),
    # fixed 0.3
    fix_thr=thr_fix,
    fix_km2=round(area_of(thr_fix),0),
    fix_presExcl=pct_pres_excl(thr_fix))
})

cat("=== Threshold values (/1000) ===\n")
print(cmp[,c("Group","n","pres_median",
  "TSS_thr","maxSSS_thr","p10_thr","fix_thr")],
  row.names=FALSE)

cat("\n=== Current suitable area (km2) ===\n")
print(cmp[,c("Group","TSS_km2","maxSSS_km2",
  "p10_km2","fix_km2")], row.names=FALSE)

cat("\n=== % of occurrences EXCLUDED by threshold ===\n")
cat("(low = threshold captures most known sites)\n")
print(cmp[,c("Group","TSS_presExcl",
  "maxSSS_presExcl","p10_presExcl",
  "fix_presExcl")], row.names=FALSE)

write.csv(cmp,"outputs/tables/threshold_comparison.csv",row.names=FALSE)

#Method 5:DSS, MCC, F-measure vs p10
thr_seq <- seq(1, 999, by=2)

cmp <- purrr::map_dfr(sdm_groups, function(g){
  g_c <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]","_",g)
  rfull <- terra::rast(paste0(
    "outputs/models/",g_c,"_current.tif"))
  cur <- terra::mask(rfull, sampled_v)
  vals_all <- terra::values(cur)[, 1]; ok_v <- !is.na(vals_all)
  vals <- vals_all[ok_v]; a_ok <- a_all[ok_v]

  pres_xy <- metadata |>
    dplyr::filter(Groups==g) |>
    dplyr::select(Longitude, Latitude)
  P <- terra::extract(rfull,
    as.matrix(pres_xy))[,1]; P <- P[!is.na(P)]
  B <- terra::extract(rfull,
    as.matrix(bg$coords))[,1]; B <- B[!is.na(B)]

  met <- sapply(thr_seq, function(th){
    # cast to double immediately
    TP <- as.double(sum(P>=th))
    FN <- as.double(sum(P<th))
    FP <- as.double(sum(B>=th))
    TN <- as.double(sum(B<th))
    sens <- TP/(TP+FN)
    spec <- TN/(TN+FP)
    prec <- if((TP+FP)>0) TP/(TP+FP) else 0
    F1 <- if((prec+sens)>0)
      2*prec*sens/(prec+sens) else 0
    mcc_den <- sqrt(
      (TP+FP)*(TP+FN)*(TN+FP)*(TN+FN))  # now double
    mcc <- if(mcc_den>0)
      (TP*TN-FP*FN)/mcc_den else 0
    c(sens=sens, spec=spec,
      tss=sens+spec-1,
      dss=abs(sens-spec),
      mcc=mcc, f=F1)
  })
  met <- t(met)

  thr_dss <- thr_seq[which.min(met[,"dss"])]
  thr_mcc <- thr_seq[which.max(met[,"mcc"])]
  thr_f   <- thr_seq[which.max(met[,"f"])]
  thr_p10 <- as.numeric(quantile(P,0.10))

  area_of <- function(th) sum(a_ok[vals>=th])
  excl    <- function(th) round(mean(P<th)*100,1)

  data.frame(
    Group=g, n=length(P),
    DSS_thr=thr_dss, DSS_km2=round(area_of(thr_dss),0),
      DSS_excl=excl(thr_dss),
    MCC_thr=thr_mcc, MCC_km2=round(area_of(thr_mcc),0),
      MCC_excl=excl(thr_mcc),
    F_thr=thr_f, F_km2=round(area_of(thr_f),0),
      F_excl=excl(thr_f),
    p10_thr=round(thr_p10,0),
      p10_km2=round(area_of(thr_p10),0),
      p10_excl=excl(thr_p10))
})

cat("=== Threshold values (/1000) ===\n")
print(cmp[,c("Group","n","DSS_thr","MCC_thr",
  "F_thr","p10_thr")], row.names=FALSE)
cat("\n=== Current area (km2) ===\n")
print(cmp[,c("Group","DSS_km2","MCC_km2",
  "F_km2","p10_km2")], row.names=FALSE)
cat("\n=== % occurrences excluded ===\n")
print(cmp[,c("Group","DSS_excl","MCC_excl",
  "F_excl","p10_excl")], row.names=FALSE)

write.csv(cmp,"outputs/tables/threshold_comparison2.csv",row.names=FALSE)
```

#DSS and TSS frozen thresholds from baseline

```{r}
ref <- terra::rast("outputs/models/Rhizobium_cluster_current.tif")

sampled_v <- terra::vect(
  sampled_mask_sf |> sf::st_make_valid() |>
  sf::st_union() |> sf::st_make_valid())

# per-cell area in km², as a plain vector aligned to ref's grid
cell_km2 <- terra::cellSize(ref, unit = "km", mask = FALSE)
a_all    <- terra::values(cell_km2)[, 1]
rm(cell_km2); invisible(gc())

thr_seq <- seq(1, 999, by = 2)
ssps    <- c("SSP245_2050", "SSP585_2050", "SSP245_2070", "SSP585_2070")

# Freeze DSS + TSS per lineage (baseline only)
thresholds <- purrr::map_dfr(sdm_groups, function(g) {
  g_c   <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "_", g)
  rfull <- terra::rast(paste0("outputs/models/", g_c, "_current.tif"))

  pxy <- metadata |> dplyr::filter(Groups == g) |>
    dplyr::select(Longitude, Latitude)
  P <- terra::extract(rfull, as.matrix(pxy))[, 1]; P <- P[!is.na(P)]
  B <- terra::extract(rfull, as.matrix(bg$coords))[, 1]; B <- B[!is.na(B)]

  th_tss <- tss_thresh |> dplyr::filter(Group == g) |> dplyr::pull(TSS_cutoff)
  dss    <- sapply(thr_seq, function(t) abs(mean(P >= t) - mean(B < t)))
  th_dss <- thr_seq[which.min(dss)]

  data.frame(Group = g,
             DSS = round(th_dss, 1), TSS = round(th_tss, 1),
             margin_floor = min(th_dss, th_tss),
             core_bound   = max(th_dss, th_tss))
})
saveRDS(thresholds, "data/processed/coremargin_thresholds.rds")

# ΔCore% and ΔMargin% (frozen thresholds)
cm <- purrr::map_dfr(sdm_groups, function(g) {
  g_c <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "_", g)
  th  <- thresholds |> dplyr::filter(Group == g)
  lo  <- th$margin_floor; hi <- th$core_bound

  cur <- terra::mask(terra::rast(paste0(
    "outputs/models/", g_c, "_current.tif")), sampled_v)
  vc  <- terra::values(cur)[, 1]
  okc <- !is.na(vc)
  core_c <- sum(a_all[okc & vc >= hi])
  marg_c <- sum(a_all[okc & vc >= lo & vc < hi])
  rm(cur, vc, okc); invisible(gc())

  out <- purrr::map_dfr(ssps, function(sc) {
    fut <- terra::mask(terra::rast(paste0(
      "outputs/models/", g_c, "_", sc, ".tif")), sampled_v)
    vf  <- terra::values(fut)[, 1]
    okf <- !is.na(vf)
    core_f <- sum(a_all[okf & vf >= hi])
    marg_f <- sum(a_all[okf & vf >= lo & vf < hi])
    rm(fut, vf, okf); invisible(gc())

    dcore <- (core_f - core_c) / max(core_c, 1) * 100
    dmarg <- (marg_f - marg_c) / max(marg_c, 1) * 100

    data.frame(Group=g, Scenario=sc,
      margin_floor=lo, core_bound=hi,
      Core_cur=round(core_c,0), Core_fut=round(core_f,0),
      Core_pct=round(dcore,1),
      Margin_cur=round(marg_c,0), Margin_fut=round(marg_f,0),
      Margin_pct=round(dmarg,1))
  })
  terra::tmpFiles(remove = TRUE)
  cat("  done:", g, "\n")
  out
})
write.csv(cm, "outputs/tables/Table_core_margin_DSS_TSS.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```

```{r}
}
```

#Core and margin projections for genus

```{r}
zone_cols <- c("Core"="#B2182B","Margin"="#FDAE61")
bb <- sf::st_bbox(sampled_mask_sf)
xl <- c(-20, 52); yl <- c(-35, 38)
cell_km2 <- terra::cellSize(
  terra::rast("outputs/models/Rhizobium_cluster_current.tif"),
  unit="km", mask=FALSE)
a_all <- terra::values(cell_km2)[,1]; rm(cell_km2); gc()

area_rows <- list()

#core/margin, union of member lineages, per genus × scenario
for (gen in names(genus_members)) {
  members <- genus_members[[gen]]
  for (sc in scen_all) {
    core_u <- NULL; marg_u <- NULL
    for (m in members) {
      m_c <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]","_",m)
      th  <- thresholds |> dplyr::filter(Group==m)
      lo  <- th$margin_floor; hi <- th$core_bound
      r   <- terra::rast(paste0("outputs/models/",m_c,"_",sc,".tif"))
      cm_ <- r >= hi; mm_ <- (r >= lo) & (r < hi)   
      core_u <- if(is.null(core_u)) cm_ else max(core_u,cm_,na.rm=TRUE)
      marg_u <- if(is.null(marg_u)) mm_ else max(marg_u,mm_,na.rm=TRUE)
      rm(r,cm_,mm_); gc()
    }
    zr <- terra::mask(terra::ifel(core_u==1, 3, terra::ifel(marg_u==1, 2, NA)),
                      sampled_v)

    zv <- terra::values(zr)[,1]; ok <- !is.na(zv)
    area_rows[[paste(gen,sc)]] <- data.frame(Genus=gen, Scenario=sc,
      Core_km2   = round(sum(a_all[ok & zv==3]),0),
      Margin_km2 = round(sum(a_all[ok & zv==2]),0))

    zdf <- as.data.frame(zr, xy=TRUE, na.rm=TRUE); names(zdf)[3] <- "z"
    zdf$zone <- factor(dplyr::recode(zdf$z, `2`="Margin", `3`="Core"),
                       levels=c("Core","Margin"))
    zdf <- zdf |> dplyr::filter(!is.na(zone))

    p <- ggplot2::ggplot() +
      ggplot2::geom_sf(data=africa_outline, fill="#EDEDED", colour=NA) +
      ggplot2::geom_sf(data=sampled_mask_sf, fill="#F7F7F7",
                       colour="grey55", linewidth=0.3) +
      ggplot2::geom_tile(data=zdf, ggplot2::aes(x,y,fill=zone)) +
      ggplot2::geom_sf(data=sampled_mask_sf, fill=NA, colour="black",
                       linewidth=0.35) +
      ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values=zone_cols, breaks=c("Core","Margin"),
        name="Habitat zone",
        guide=ggplot2::guide_legend(override.aes=list(size=4))) +
      ggplot2::coord_sf(xlim=xl, ylim=yl, expand=FALSE) +
      ggplot2::labs(title=paste0(gen," \u2014 ",scen_title[sc]),
        subtitle="Core/margin: union of member lineages",
        x=NULL, y=NULL) +
      ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size=12) +
      ggplot2::theme(
        plot.title=ggplot2::element_text(size=13,face="bold.italic",hjust=0.5),
        plot.subtitle=ggplot2::element_text(size=10,hjust=0.5,colour="grey40"),
        panel.grid=ggplot2::element_blank(),
        panel.border=ggplot2::element_rect(colour="black",fill=NA,linewidth=0.6),
        axis.text=ggplot2::element_text(size=13,colour="black"),
        legend.title=ggplot2::element_text(size=15,face="bold"),
        legend.text=ggplot2::element_text(size=13),
        plot.background=ggplot2::element_rect(fill="white",colour=NA)) +
      ggspatial::annotation_scale(location="bl", width_hint=0.3, text_cex=0.55,
                                  bar_cols=c("black","white")) +
      ggspatial::annotation_north_arrow(location="tr", which_north="true",
        height=ggplot2::unit(0.8,"cm"), width=ggplot2::unit(0.6,"cm"),
        style=ggspatial::north_arrow_fancy_orienteering())

    ggsave(paste0("outputs/maps/Fig_cm_genus_",gen,"_",sc,".png"), p, width=7, height=7, dpi=320, bg="white")
  }
  terra::tmpFiles(remove=TRUE); cat("  core/margin:", gen, "done\n")
}
#Table genus core margin

          row.names=FALSE)
cat("\n=== Genus areas (km²) ===\n")
print(genus_areas, row.names=FALSE)
cat("\nAll genus maps done.\n")
```

#core and margin delta areas table

```{r}
ref <- terra::rast("outputs/models/Rhizobium_cluster_current.tif")
cell_km2 <- terra::cellSize(ref, unit = "km", mask = FALSE)   

country_lookup <- c(
  "Ang"="Angola","Esw"="Kingdom of eSwatini",
  "Eth"="Ethiopia","Gha"="Ghana","Ken"="Kenya",
  "Moz"="Mozambique","Nam"="Namibia",
  "SA"="South Africa","Sen"="Senegal")
ssps <- c("SSP245_2050","SSP585_2050","SSP245_2070","SSP585_2070")

#Core & margin area within a mask vector
zone_areas <- function(r, mv, lo, hi, area_r){                 
  r_m <- terra::mask(r, mv)
  a_m <- terra::mask(area_r, mv)
  v <- terra::values(r_m)[,1]; a <- terra::values(a_m)[,1]
  ok <- !is.na(v)
  c(core   = sum(a[ok][v[ok] >= hi]),
    margin = sum(a[ok][v[ok] >= lo & v[ok] < hi]))
}

core_country <- purrr::map_dfr(sdm_groups, function(g){
  g_c <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]","_",g)
  th <- thresholds |> dplyr::filter(Group==g)
  lo <- th$margin_floor; hi <- th$core_bound
  cur <- terra::rast(paste0("outputs/models/",g_c,"_current.tif"))

  purrr::map_dfr(names(country_lookup), function(cc){
    csf <- sampled_mask_sf |>
      dplyr::filter(name_long==country_lookup[cc] | name==country_lookup[cc])
    if (nrow(csf)==0) return(NULL)
    cv <- terra::vect(csf |> sf::st_make_valid() |>
      sf::st_union() |> sf::st_make_valid())
    ac <- zone_areas(cur, cv, lo, hi, cell_km2)

    purrr::map_dfr(ssps, function(sc){
      fut <- terra::rast(paste0("outputs/models/",g_c,"_",sc,".tif"))
      af <- zone_areas(fut, cv, lo, hi, cell_km2)

      core_delta <- af["core"] - ac["core"]                    
      marg_delta <- af["margin"] - ac["margin"]
      core_pct <- if (ac["core"]   == 0) NA_real_ else round(core_delta/ac["core"]*100, 1)   
      marg_pct <- if (ac["margin"] == 0) NA_real_ else round(marg_delta/ac["margin"]*100, 1)  

      data.frame(Lineage=g, Country=country_lookup[cc],
        Core_cur=round(ac["core"],0), Core_fut=round(af["core"],0),
        Core_delta_km2=round(core_delta,0),                    
        Core_change_pct=core_pct,
        Margin_cur=round(ac["margin"],0), Margin_fut=round(af["margin"],0),
        Margin_delta_km2=round(marg_delta,0),                 
        Margin_change_pct=marg_pct)
    })
  })
})

write.csv(core_country,"outputs/tables/coremargin_by_country.csv", row.names=FALSE)
```
